contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: Well this is grand darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.player: Thank you. Nice to meet you too.
Wait a minute. How am I talking to you without a Camulet?

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.player: Hmmm. I suppose this spell must tap directly into your mind. So, there's no need for language to get in the way.

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: I think I am somewhat confused.
May one ask how you contacted me?

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.player: I'm just using one of the Lunar spells.

contacting-through-astral-contacts-rando.npc: Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new-fangled gadgets!
